A few things I can put in your hands right away:

- **Messaging and calls** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want one?
- **Accounts on the web** — I can sign myself up for websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — scheduling jobs, running commands, languages and voice.

If the calendar changes or a message needs handling, just tell me — or I can watch my inbox and calendar for you.

One small thing: your config names me diego-agent; I use neuter forms for myself (it/they) unless you'd rather set that differently.
